title: Be a licensed chattel auctioneer
what: Auction goods (chattels) only while holding a chattel auctioneer licence; real estate auctioneers are licensed under the Property Occupations Act 2014.

laws.title: Motor Dealers and Chattel Auctioneers Act 2014 (Qld)

sources.title: Motor Dealers and Chattel Auctioneers Act 2014 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not perform an activity that may be done under the authority of a chattel auctioneer licence unless the person— (a) holds a chattel auctioneer licence and the performance of the activity is authorised under the person’s licence

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Motor Dealers and Chattel Auctioneers Act 2014 (Qld)
